name: ordered-dither-pass
description: Bayer-matrix ordered dithering quantizes a slotted scene (rasterized once at mount): the image emerges from pure 2-tone noise to clean, or dissolves the reverse. Stateless per frame, never error diffusion.

vars.description: Bayer matrix size: 2 is the coarsest crosshatch, 8 the smoothest ordered grain.
in resolves noise to clean; out dissolves clean to noise and holds it.
Quantization levels per color channel during the dithered phase.
Light tone of the 2-tone noise phase: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
Optional departure. Default none: the final state holds until the frame cuts.
